column1: # TLA English overlay identities derived from the ROM location-name resolver, not source filenames.

# Scene records: 080f17a8 holds 8-byte {u16 overlay, u8 area, u8 variant, u16 map_index, u16 mode}; every overlay a field scene loads is listed except the title, staff credits, epilogue and face-test scenes, whose maps are shared.
# Name rules: resolver 080ca280 scans 080ef4a4 in order. Bit 15 of the selector matches the scene instead of the area; its low 15 bits select an entry or 0x7fff as a wildcard.

# The matched result plus 0xe58 is the English location name; the Japanese catalog starts its names at 0xe5a and each scene's debug label at 0xebc plus the scene index. Message IDs refer to TEXT/MESSAGE_ARCHIVE.JSON.
# resource_652 shows North Osenia Islet only for scene 11 entry 7; every other Daila entry resolves to Daila.
# English display names identify places; atlas destinations are romaji of the Japanese place names plus one area word, as in The Broken Seal: デリィ村 (0xe62) is DERI_MURA.
# The debug labels choose among a place's area words (ROOM rooms as HEYA, the sanctum as SHINDEN) but never name a folder. Modules serving several places live in SRC/FIELD/COMMON.
